## Per-product capture summary

### 1. SAIGE — Demo Readiness **74/100**

**URL:** https://saigedemo.com
**Title:** "SAIGE | Enterprise Impact Performance Platform"
**Pitch:** "SAIGE unifies ESG, Sustainability, SDGs, EHS and CSR into a single Enterprise Impact Performance (EIP) score — giving leaders the tools to act responsibly across People, Planet, Peace, Progress and Profits."

**Primary objective:** Capture early-access registrations to build a pre-launch waitlist of founding members before full platform launch at SaigePlatform.com.

**Information architecture (5 sections):**
1. Hero / Problem Statement — pain framing + white paper CTA + demo explainer toggle.
2. Live Demo / Animation Block — auto-cycling EIP scoring widget across School / Business / NGO / Energy / etc.
3. Why SAIGE Matters / Social Proof Stats — KPMG, MIT Sloan, Deloitte, Gartner citations + comparison table.
4. Five Sources Consolidated — without-vs-with value proposition + one beta testimonial.
5. About / Team + Early Access Form — founder credentials (Victor Udo, FNSE, PhD) + the conversion form.

**Trust signals captured:** four named third-party stats, one beta testimonial (anonymous "Manufacturing"), founder credentials, framework compatibility callouts (GRI, CSRD, TCFD, ISO 45001, UN SDGs), proprietary IP / CFAA notice.

**Top 3 priorities for tomorrow:**
1. **[P0 conversion]** Move early-access form above the fold — currently buried below demo, four stat blocks, comparison table, testimonial, and founder bio.
2. **[P0 trust]** Replace the single anonymous beta testimonial with at least 2 named, role-attributed quotes + 1 quantified internal-testing outcome.
3. **[P1 a11y]** Fix heading hierarchy (h3 elements appear before h2) and add alt-text to the auto-cycling demo widget — current state is a WCAG 2.1 Level A failure for the most differentiated section of the page.

### 2. PressAI — Demo Readiness **62/100**

**URL:** https://ourpublishingai.com
**Title:** "PressAI — From Idea to Global Impact"
**Pitch:** Agentic AI Publishing Platform — SaaS & Native App. "9 end-to-end agentic workflows that take any person or organization from concept to published, distributed and monetized knowledge — on any device, anywhere in the world."

**Primary objective:** Drive free sign-ups via "Get Started Free", with secondary objectives of plan upgrades (Creator $29/mo, Professional $99/mo, Enterprise Custom).

**Information architecture (5 sections):**
1. Hero — headline, three stat chips (9 AI Workflows / 50+ Distribution Channels / 100% AI-Powered Global Reach), "Get Started Free" CTA.
2. 9 Complete Publishing Workflows — numbered grid, each tagline an input-to-output transformation.
3. Everything You Need to Publish and Grow — 6 feature cards (writing, distribution, royalties, collaboration, social, export).
4. Simple Transparent Pricing — 4-tier table.
5. Closing CTA / Footer.

**Trust signals captured:** quantitative stat chips (unsourced), closing copy "Join authors and publishers" with no named users, no third-party logos, no press mentions, no testimonials.

**Top 3 priorities for tomorrow:**
1. **[P0 trust]** Add named author/publisher testimonials with headshots + outcome metric + publication title — placed between the workflows grid and feature cards. Currently page asks for trust based on unverified superlatives, untenable for a $29-$99/mo SaaS.
2. **[P0 conversion]** Embed an inline email-capture in the hero — every CTA currently exits to an off-page registration flow. Eliminates the dropout gap, especially severe on mobile where redirect latency is highest.
3. **[P1 trust + copy]** Source/verify the hero stat chips ("9 AI Workflows", "50+ Distribution Channels", "100% AI-Powered Global Reach") via tooltips or methodology page; clarify what "Agentic AI" means for non-technical buyers (authors, small publishers) — this terminology is opaque to the primary audience.

### 3. MyBirthSafe — Demo Readiness **2/100** ⚠

**URL:** https://safe-path.base44.app
**Title:** *(none captured — page returned an error)*
**Reality:** The Base44-hosted endpoint returns a JSON error payload (`App not found`). There is **no product** at this URL right now. Architecture analysis correctly identified this:

2. **[P0 critical]** If the app has migrated to a new URL, set up a 301 redirect on `safe-path.base44.app`. If it has been retired, replace with a holding page that explains status and captures contact info.
3. **[P0 governance]** Audit every other Base44-hosted product in the portfolio for the same failure class (RelTwin earlier showed a placeholder, MyBirthSafe shows an error). This is a host-dependency pattern, not a one-off.

## Portfolio observations

### Common theme 1 — Trust signal deficit on the live products

Both successfully captured live products (SAIGE, PressAI) flagged "missing customer logos / case studies / live demo / named testimonials" as their **#1 priority** in Claude's improvement plan. This is a portfolio-level pattern: VEU is investing heavily in problem framing, value-proposition copy, and pricing tiers, but underweighting third-party validation.

**Recommendation:** Build a portfolio-shared trust component (logo wall + 2-3 named customer testimonials slot + live demo screenshot slot) and roll it into both products as a single design-system PR.

### Common theme 2 — Conversion form below the fold / off-page

Both live products bury the primary conversion action:
- **SAIGE:** form is at the bottom of a long scroll, after demo + stats + comparison + testimonial + founder bio.
- **PressAI:** every CTA links away to an off-page registration; no inline form on landing.

**Recommendation:** Standardise on a hero-level inline email-capture pattern across all flagship products. Single field + button, zero navigation cost.

### Common theme 3 — Hosting fragility on Base44

Two of three captured products show Base44-host failure modes (MyBirthSafe error JSON; RelTwin placeholder from earlier scan). This is a structural risk: products built on a hosted-builder platform that doesn't fail closed gracefully when an app is unpublished or retired.

**Recommendation:** Add a Self-Renewal cron (`/api/self-renewal/check`) that runs nightly against every active product URL. Auto-downgrade status from `active` to `broken` (with human-review gate) when quality drops below 30. Tomorrow's `INNGEST_*` activation makes this a 5-minute setup using the existing `cost-rollup-daily` pattern.

### Common theme 4 — Accessibility gaps on JS-rendered pages

SAIGE in particular has documented a11y gaps: heading hierarchy out of sequence, no alt-text on the demo widget, emoji-as-functional-icons without aria-labels (WCAG 2.1 Level A failure). PressAI's a11y signals were inconclusive but no aria landmarks were detected.

**Recommendation:** Add a quarterly a11y audit pass — re-use `/api/configuration/clone` with an objective: "accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA)" to surface the same audit lens specifically.

### Design consistency observation

The two live products (SAIGE, PressAI) share a **stat-chip pattern** in the hero (SAIGE: KPMG/MIT/Deloitte/Gartner stats; PressAI: 9/50+/100%). Neither sources their numbers in-band. This suggests an emerging VEU design idiom worth either (a) standardising with a verifiable-stat component, or (b) abandoning in favour of pure customer testimonials.

## Reproducing this report

```bash
ORG=veu-ai-studio

for entry in \
  "saige|https://saigedemo.com" \
  "pressai|https://ourpublishingai.com" \
  "mybirthsafe|https://safe-path.base44.app"; do
  IFS='|' read -r SLUG URL <<< "$entry"
  curl -s -X POST https://flowai-dun.vercel.app/api/configuration/clone \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "x-flowai-org-id: $ORG" \
    -d "{
      \"url\":\"$URL\",
      \"product_id\":\"$SLUG\",
      \"org_id\":\"$ORG\",
      \"options\":{
        \"captureScreenshot\":true,
        \"architectureAnalysis\":true,
        \"improvementPlan\":true
      }
    }" \
    --max-time 180 > "/tmp/$SLUG.json"
done
```

Each call returns `{ ok, run_id, snapshot, architecture, improvement_plan, quality_score, cost_usd, durationMs }`.
